title: Interval tensors compare ordinary and enriched infinity localizations
statement:
Use simplicial categories, locally Kan replacement and the homotopy coherent nerve as in [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison], and infinity categories, functor categories and equivalences as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Enlarge universes so that every category in this statement is small. Let $\mathcal C$ be a simplicial category and let $\mathcal C_0$ be its underlying ordinary category, with morphisms the vertices of its mapping simplicial sets. Let $W$ be a class of morphisms of $\mathcal C_0$ containing all isomorphisms and satisfying two-out-of-three for composition. Suppose that for every $X$ there is an object $I X$ and a simplicial map $h_X:\Delta^1\to\mathcal C(X,I X)$ such that composition with $h_X$ induces an isomorphism of simplicial sets
$$\mathcal C(I X,Y)\xrightarrow{\sim}\underline{\operatorname{Map}}_{\mathrm{sSet}}(\Delta^1,\mathcal C(X,Y))$$
natural in $Y$. Here the simplicial function complex has $n$-simplices the maps $\Delta^n\times\Delta^1\to\mathcal C(X,Y)$. Let $p_X:I X\to X$ correspond under this isomorphism to the constant path at $1_X$, and assume $p_X\in W$ for every $X$.

Choose an object-preserving locally Kan replacement $r:\mathcal C\to R\mathcal C$ inducing weak homotopy equivalences on mapping simplicial sets. Put $\mathcal D=N_{\mathrm{hc}}(R\mathcal C)$, and let $V$ be the edges of $\mathcal D$ corresponding to the vertices $r(w)$ for $w\in W$. The discrete enrichment of $\mathcal C_0$ maps to $R\mathcal C$, giving a canonical functor $\theta:N(\mathcal C_0)\to\mathcal D$. For every infinity category $\mathcal E$, restriction along $\theta$ gives an equivalence
$$\operatorname{Fun}_{V}(\mathcal D,\mathcal E)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Fun}_{W}(N(\mathcal C_0),\mathcal E),$$
where the subscripts specify the full functor infinity subcategories on functors inverting the indicated edges. Equivalently, $\theta$ induces an equivalence $N(\mathcal C_0)[W^{-1}]_\infty\simeq\mathcal D[V^{-1}]_\infty$, where localization is universal on entire functor infinity categories. No model structure, fibrancy of the original mapping sets, or tensors other than these interval objects are assumed.
